claim: NP-completeness under polynomial-time many-one reductions of conservative chip-firing halting for nonnegative configurations on finite loopless simple strongly connected directed graphs; hardness even when deleting one vertex leaves a depth-at-most-one DAG and total chips are polynomially bounded in SAT input length.

independent_tests.limitation: Exact finite tests supplement, and do not replace, the independently reviewed general proof.
negative_controls: one excess total chip creates detected false-negative
three missing total chips create detected false-positive

scope_exclusions: No claim that finite tests substitute for the general proof.
No conflation with problem 3000016 multigraph reachability.

oriented_appendix.claim: The same hardness holds for oriented graphs with no antiparallel arcs; uses directed three-cycle trivial instances.
oriented_appendix.name: ORIENTED_APPENDIX.md

acceptance_basis: Complete written modular-bank reduction and separate mathematical audit of the main proof and oriented appendix; prior NP membership credited to Farrell and Levine, CoEulerian graphs, Section 3. Finite checks are supporting metadata only.
sources_verified_scope: Recorded proof-review and independent-audit observations; edition preparation did not retrieve, rehash, or inspect scholarly sources anew.
